info.title: TestGen API
info.summary: REST API for DataOps Data Quality TestGen.
info.description:
Automate profiling, test execution, and test generation jobs. Export and import test definitions for promotion across environments.

**Authentication**: OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow. See `GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` for discovery.

OAuth clients use this for server discovery.
Show login form for authorization code flow, or skip if already logged in.

Enforces same-origin on redirect_uri to prevent open redirect attacks.

get.description: List job executions for a project, with optional filters and pagination.

Per-table monitoring summary for a table group, with group totals.

Each row nests per-type state: ``freshness`` / ``volume`` / ``schema`` (one monitor each)
and ``metrics`` (one per metric). ``anomalies_only`` restricts to tables with at least one
anomaly of any type. ``monitor_id`` on a per-type object addresses that monitor's series.

A monitor's lookback time-series, type-discriminated, with a self-contained header.

``points`` shape depends on ``type``:
- volume / metric: ``{time, value, lower_bound, upper_bound, threshold_value, is_anomaly, is_training, is_error, is_pending}``
- freshness: ``{time, minutes_since_update, staleness_threshold, lower_bound, upper_bound, update_detected, is_anomaly, is_training, is_error, is_pending}``
- schema: ``{time, table_change, additions, deletions, modifications, window_start, is_error}``

``current_bands`` carries the latest thresholds (null while training); its shape also
depends on ``type``. The latest point is the monitor's current state.
Get a test run by the job execution ID that created it.

List individual results for a test run.

Omitting ``disposition`` returns active results — confirmed and no_decision
(excludes dismissed and muted); pass an explicit value to filter to one state.

List data-quality hygiene issues for a profiling run.

Excludes Potential PII findings, which are listed by
``/profiling-runs/{job_id}/potential-pii``. Omitting ``disposition``
returns confirmed issues; pass ``dismissed`` or ``muted`` to filter to
those states. Callers without ``view_pii`` on the run's project see
``[PII Redacted]`` in ``detail`` for PII-flagged rows.

parameters.name: issue_type

schema.description: Filter to one issue type, given as its id — the value returned in each issue's `issue_type`, e.g. `1002`.

parameters.description: Filter to one issue type, given as its id — the value returned in each issue's `issue_type`, e.g. `1002`.

get.description:
List Potential PII findings for a profiling run.

Companion to ``/profiling-runs/{job_id}/hygiene-issues``. Omitting
``disposition`` returns confirmed findings; pass ``dismissed`` or
``muted`` to filter to those states. Callers without ``view_pii`` on
the run's project see ``[PII Redacted]`` in ``detail``.

List per-column profiles for a profiling run.

The default ``hygiene_severity`` sort orders columns worst-first by the tuple
``(definite, likely, possible, high, moderate)`` — a column with any Definite hygiene
issue outranks any column with none regardless of lower-severity counts. Use
``sort=table`` for a stable per-table listing (schema, table, column position).

``table_name`` is a case-sensitive exact match: source-system casing is preserved.

``profiling_score``, ``testing_score``, and ``pii_flag`` on each returned item reflect
the column's current values from the catalog — a column that has been re-profiled
since the pinned run still reports the latest scores and classification.

get.summary: Quality Score rollup for a project
get.description:
Quality Score rollup for a project.

Returns the overall Testing Score (``total`` / ``cde`` / ``profiling`` / ``testing``).
When ``group_by`` is supplied, adds a ``breakdown`` ordered by ``impact`` descending —
the actionable signal for which group accounts for the most of the score's
affected data points. ``impact_dimension`` is the recommended primary breakdown.

Filter query params are repeatable: repeats within one field OR together, different
fields AND together. ``quality_dimension``, ``impact_dimension`` and ``table_group``
are groupable only, not filterable.

ErrorResponse.description: Standardized error response for business logic errors (400, 404, 409).

HygieneIssueCounts.description: Counts of active data-quality hygiene issues by likelihood category.

HygieneIssueItem.description: One data-quality hygiene issue in a profiling run.

HygieneIssueListResponse.description: Paginated hygiene issues for a profiling run.

ImportPayload.description: Import payload — same structure as an export document, but definitions are typed.

ImportStrictError.description: 400 response for apply_strict when entries would be skipped.

IssueCounts.description: Profiling-finding breakdown: active counts by kind, plus a single dismissed total.

JobResponse.description: Full job execution record returned by status and cancel endpoints.

JobSubmittedResponse.description: Returned on 202 Accepted after successful job submission.

MetricMonitorSummary.description: One metric monitor (per column) on a table.

MonitorSeriesResponse.description: A single monitor's lookback time-series with a self-contained header.

MonitorSummaryListResponse.description: Paginated per-table monitoring summary with group totals.

MonitorTableRow.description: Monitoring summary for a single table within the lookback window.

MonitorTotals.description: Group-wide totals across all monitored tables.

MonitorTypeSummary.description: Per-type monitoring state for a table (single-instance types).

PotentialPiiCounts.description: Counts of active Potential PII findings by risk level.

PotentialPiiItem.description: One Potential PII finding in a profiling run.

PotentialPiiListResponse.description: Paginated Potential PII findings for a profiling run.

ProfilingColumnItem.description:
One column's profile within a profiling run.

``profiling_score``, ``testing_score``, and ``pii_flag`` reflect the column's current
catalog values — a column that has been re-profiled since the pinned run still
reports the latest scores and classification.

ProfilingColumnListResponse.description: Paginated per-column profiles for a profiling run.

ProfilingRunHistoryItem.description: One profiling run in a table group's history.

ProfilingRunHistoryResponse.description: Paginated profiling-run history for a table group, newest first.

ProfilingRunResult.description: Run-specific data populated when profiling completes.

ResultCounts.description: Counts of test results by outcome status, with dismissed results separated.

SchemaMonitorSummary.description: Schema monitor state (no training mode; carries structural-change counts).

value.description: The group value (e.g. ``reliability`` for ``impact_dimension``, ``sales_db`` for ``data_source``). Null when the underlying data isn't classified into a group (e.g. an issue type with no ``impact_dimension`` assigned).

score.description: Testing Score for this group (0-100). Null when the group has no scored data points.

impact.description: Contribution to the overall score's affected data points, 0-100.

ScoreBreakdownRow.description:
One row of the group_by breakdown returned by the ``scores`` endpoint.

Rows are ordered by ``impact`` descending — the actionable signal for which
group is dragging the score down the most.

total.description: Overall Testing Score across all data in the filtered slice (0-100).

cde.description: Testing Score restricted to critical data elements in the filtered slice (0-100).

profiling.description: Profiling component of the total score (0-100).

testing.description: Testing component of the total score (0-100).

breakdown.description: Breakdown rows for the requested ``group_by``, ordered by ``impact`` descending. Absent when no ``group_by`` was provided.

ScoresResponse.description:
Quality Score rollup for a project.

Overall scores are always populated. ``breakdown`` is present iff ``group_by``
was supplied on the request; rows are ordered by ``impact`` descending. Scores
can be null when the filtered slice has no scored data points.

TestDefinitionExport.description: Test definition fields included in the export/import file.

TestResultItem.description: One individual test result within a test run.

TestResultListResponse.description: Paginated list of individual test results.

TestRunResult.description: Run-specific data populated when execution completes.
